secrets.name: NEON_DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: External Neon PostgreSQL connection string (with existing data). Optional — a local Postgres with an empty schema is used until this is provided.

secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: JWT signing secret. Optional — a dev placeholder is used until provided.

secrets.name: BUATQRIS_ACCOUNT_ID
secrets.description: BuatQris Account ID for automatic QRIS payments. Required for the automatic payment flow.

secrets.name: BUATQRIS_SECRET_TOKEN
secrets.description: BuatQris Secret Token (server-only, never sent to frontend). Required for the automatic payment flow.

secrets.name: BUATQRIS_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: BuatQris Webhook Secret for verifying X-BuatQris-Signature on webhook callbacks (server-only).

secrets.name: PUBLIC_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Public base URL of the site (e.g. https://your-domain.com) used to construct the BuatQris webhook callback URL. Optional — falls back to BASE44_PUBLIC_HOST_SUFFIX.

secrets.name: PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase PUBLIC project URL for creator/verified-creator video storage.

secrets.name: OWNER_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase OWNER project URL for owner/admin video storage.

secrets.name: MEDIA_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase MEDIA project URL for avatars/banners/images/manual QRIS.

secrets.name: KV_REST_API_URL
secrets.description: Layerbase Valkey REST API URL (Redis-compatible). Optional — app runs without it (no session invalidation or caching).

secrets.name: KV_REST_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Layerbase Valkey REST API token (server-only, never sent to frontend). Optional.

secrets.name: CRON_HEARTBEAT_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret protecting the GET /api/health/layerbase heartbeat endpoint. The external cron job sends this as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>` or `X-Cron-Secret: <secret>`. Optional — a dev placeholder is used until provided.

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Telegram Bot token (from @BotFather). The ONLY credential needed for the Telegram Video Storage module — no API ID, API Hash, or Session required. Server-only, never sent to frontend.

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Optional secret token for the Telegram webhook (sent as X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header by Telegram). Server-only. If not set, the webhook URL itself is the secret.
